scope: Classify inbound ContextVM JSON-RPC responses before Bahia request authorization and dispatch.
intended_behavior: A result or error response received on the shared ContextVM ingress produces no outbound Bahia event.
NIP-59 response rumors are authenticated, unwrapped, validated, deduplicated, and routing-checked before role classification.
JSON-RPC requests retain their existing authorization, validation, progress, dispatch, and response behavior.
out_of_scope: Consuming maintenance responses as hygiene observations, tracked by fp-20aa.
Changing NIP-59 wrapping, unwrapping, subscription, or replay behavior.
